answer: Require every agent identity to lock collateral in a bond that is slashed when the agent is caught double-voting or forging receipts. Minting a sybil therefore costs the same capital as funding a legitimate agent, and a slash destroys that capital, so an attacker who spawns a hundred fake agents must risk a hundred times the stake while rewards are split among all participants, turning the network into a garden where only identities that pay for their own upkeep extend their horizon, and honest collateral becomes a scarce oasis of credibility.
